corrections.detail: State explicitly that Capture remains before route validity handling. The current code writes the rounded BF16 value for every in-bounds logical cell even when its map is invalid. A cached invalid-token sentinel must not bypass this write. Require exact BF16 capture comparison for invalid-map cases as well as valid routes.

Replace the tentative claim that fixtures must establish whether atomic multiplicity is observable. The API exposes a uint32 status bitmask (bit 1 invalid slot, bit 2 invalid token), and the implementation/reference use fetch_or; callers compare final bits, with no invocation counter. Preserve the final OR mask and same-row precedence: invalid slot yields bit 1 and suppresses the token-error branch; bit 2 applies only after a valid slot. A producer may OR once per logical row per workgroup, including repeated work across N-tile groups. Atomic-call count is not a correctness requirement; contention is only a performance effect.

The existing fixture injects invalid slot and invalid token separately. Add a deterministic case where both are invalid for the same routed row and assert the final mask is exactly bit 1, locking the current slot-first else-if precedence.
